newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore election turnout nearly 96 percent.
newsitem.headline: Singapore election turnout nearly 96 percent.

text.p: Almost 96 percent of Singapore's 765,000 eligible voters cast their ballots in general elections on Thursday, the government's Election Department said.
Voting is compulsory in Singapore, where the People's Action Party (PAP) was returned to power before the election because opposition parties contested only 36 of parliament's 83 seats.
The Election Department said 95.86 percent of the electorate in the contested constituencies had voted in the 12 hours polling centres were open.
People over 21 who do not vote in general elections in Singapore are removed from the voters register. They have to pay Singapore $5.00 (US$3.60) to be reinstated.
